cues.en: In this part of the Let's Build a Chatbot series in C-Sharp using Agent Framework, we're going to look a little more into the Blazor server implementation.
cues.zh: 這個使用 C# 與 Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的單元，要更深入看看 Blazor Server 實作。

cues.en: We saw the baseline, but we want to go a little more deep into how we actually deal with tool calls,
cues.zh: 前面看過基本版，現在想更深入了解如何處理工具呼叫，

cues.en: because when we run, we actually want to see our tool calls inline here,
cues.zh: 因為執行時，希望直接在對話裡看到工具呼叫，

cues.en: or if not, if we don't want it to be shown to the user, perhaps we want to store it somewhere or keep it around.
cues.zh: 就算不想顯示給使用者，也可能希望儲存或保留記錄。

cues.en: And in my case, we have a little GUI here that shows the tool call input and the output, but let's talk a little more how that actually happens behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 這個例子有簡單介面，顯示工具的輸入與輸出，接著看看背後如何取得這些資料。

cues.en: So in the code, let me jump to the code here,
cues.zh: 回到程式碼，

cues.en: when we do our send message and we do our agent,
cues.zh: 送出訊息、建立代理程式時，

cues.en: we of course add the tools like normal.
cues.zh: 當然會像平常一樣加入工具。

cues.en: And we know, of course, whenever we use a tool, it's being used, and then the AI agent will give us an answer back, but we actually want the details on what happened.
cues.zh: 我們知道工具會被呼叫，最後代理程式會回覆答案，但也想取得實際過程的細節。

cues.en: We can go in and use middleware, as we have done in the past,
cues.zh: 可以像之前一樣使用中介軟體，

cues.en: or the tool calling middleware, but that's more to just log stuff.
cues.zh: 或工具呼叫中介軟體，但那主要用來記錄資訊。

cues.en: But inside a conversation, whenever we do a non-streaming response here, so let me set a breakpoint here so we can see,
cues.zh: 在對話中，如果取得非串流回應，先在這裡設中斷點，

cues.en: and restart the code.
cues.zh: 再重新啟動程式。

cues.en: We actually, in the response, have those tool calls available as well.
cues.zh: 其實回應裡也包含那些工具呼叫。

cues.en: And that is what we are going to use in order to actually show them.
cues.zh: 我們就會使用這些資訊來顯示。

cues.en: So whenever it runs, and we ask,
cues.zh: 執行後提出問題，

cues.en: what is the weather like in Delhi?
cues.zh: 德里的天氣如何？

cues.en: We are running streaming at the moment, so let me quickly just stop it here and ask the same question again.
cues.zh: 目前開著串流，先關閉，再問一次相同問題。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So in a non-streaming fashion, we will get our response back here in one second. Okay.
cues.zh: 非串流方式下，稍後會在這裡取得完整回應。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 取得了。

cues.en: So we got our response, we sent our message, what is the weather like in Delhi, and we got our response back,
cues.zh: 我們送出「德里的天氣如何？」，現在收到回應，

cues.en: which was, current weather is here.
cues.zh: 內容是目前天氣資訊。

cues.en: But behind the scenes, of course, we don't have just that one message, we have multiple messages here.
cues.zh: 但背後不只有這一則訊息，而是多則。

cues.en: First up being reasoning, then the tool call result, and then the final answer.
cues.zh: 先有推理，再有工具呼叫結果，最後是答案。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, we have these various things for content and so on, and the easiest way to actually look at them is in the way we store these.
cues.zh: 裡面有各種 Content。最容易理解的方式，是查看儲存後的內容。

cues.en: If I just took such a response and serialized it, it would look something like this.
cues.zh: 如果直接把這份回應序列化，就會長這樣。

cues.en: So inside a raw message, we get an author name, a created, a user, and so on, and we get these content parts.
cues.zh: 原始訊息包含作者名稱、建立時間、角色等資訊，還有這些 Content 部分。

cues.en: So whenever, in this case, I said hi, and we can actually take the one we just ran.
cues.zh: 這個例子原本只是說你好，也可以改看剛剛執行的結果。

cues.en: So let me close this one.
cues.zh: 先關掉這個。

cues.en: And let's find the latest one, that's this one.
cues.zh: 找最新的一份，就是這個。

cues.en: This is the one we asked for, what is the weather like in Delhi.
cues.zh: 這是剛剛詢問德里天氣的對話。

cues.en: So let's have a look.
cues.zh: 看看內容。

cues.en: So we have our user input, and we have that boat as text here.
cues.zh: 這裡有使用者輸入，既可以直接取得文字，

cues.en: And as content here.
cues.zh: 也會放在 Content 中。

cues.en: And then we begin to get our message back, and we get both reasoning as content, but also the function calls as content.
cues.zh: 接著開始取得回應，推理是 Content，函式呼叫也是 Content。

cues.en: So in here, we have that we get a function call, what tool we want to call with which arguments, and we get a call ID.
cues.zh: 其中 FunctionCall 會說明要呼叫哪個工具、使用哪些參數，並提供 CallId。

cues.en: So this is what is being sent to the LLM, and of course, we want to show that, and that's what we're doing up here.
cues.zh: 這是與 LLM 溝通的內容，我們當然希望顯示出來，也就是上面這部分。

cues.en: Now we have a breakpoint, let me remove that breakpoint so we can see things in real life.
cues.zh: 現在有中斷點，先移除，看看實際介面。

cues.en: There we go. So this is what we have here.
cues.zh: 好了，這就是目前顯示的內容。

cues.en: So if we go back, we want to visualize this because it comes back as our response.
cues.zh: 回到程式碼，希望呈現這些回應資料。

cues.en: But we also want to have both the function call, as we saw, but also the response back,
cues.zh: 但不只有剛剛看到的函式呼叫，也要顯示回傳結果，

cues.en: which is our function sort type coming back in another message.
cues.zh: 也就是另一則訊息中的 FunctionResultContent。

cues.en: And these results back always come back as the role tool, so we need to build these up together.
cues.zh: 這些結果總是以 tool 角色回傳，因此需要把兩者組合起來。

cues.en: And the important part here in the result is that it also have a call ID so we can match up the request with the result.
cues.zh: 結果中最重要的是也有 CallId，可以把要求與結果配對。

cues.en: So in the code, whenever we do this and it's non-streaming, we just use that response with all the tools in, in order to visualize.
cues.zh: 因此非串流時，就使用包含所有工具資訊的完整回應來呈現。

cues.en: So up here, the user message is just plain input text, so that's nothing there.
cues.zh: 上面的使用者訊息只是一般輸入文字，沒有特別之處。

cues.en: But whenever we get to the assistant parts, we want to have, to show the tool call, and that's what we're doing in this little component here.
cues.zh: 但到助理訊息時，需要顯示工具呼叫，這就是這個小元件的工作。

cues.en: And in order to do that, we get the messages and the content of those messages, because that's what we just saw in here,
cues.zh: 因此取得訊息與訊息中的 Content，因為剛剛看到，

cues.en: that it's the content parts here that we need to do to put in.
cues.zh: 需要的就是這些 Content 部分。

cues.en: But we also need the entire conversation, because in another message, we got the result back.
cues.zh: 另外也要提供完整對話，因為工具結果放在另一則訊息裡。

cues.en: So in order to link those together, we send both of these into this little tool, or this little component.
cues.zh: 為了把兩者連起來，就把它們一起傳入這個小元件。

cues.en: And what we can do is, of course, just find all of all the content, which is multiple, both text and reasoning and stuff,
cues.zh: 接著從所有 Content 中尋找，裡面可能有文字、推理等多種內容，

cues.en: we want all the ones that are called function call content.
cues.zh: 只取出 FunctionCallContent。

cues.en: So these are the requests we are getting sent.
cues.zh: 這些就是模型提出的工具呼叫要求。

cues.en: And we just want to show that tool call.
cues.zh: 我們要把它顯示出來。

cues.en: Again, if we take the GUI, that is this part up here.
cues.zh: 回到介面，就是上面這個部分。

cues.en: So we are showing that.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示工具呼叫。

cues.en: And in my case, I've made this extension method in order to do that, because inside the content, we have a name,
cues.zh: 我為此寫了一個擴充方法，因為 Content 裡有 Name，

cues.en: which is the tool name we called.
cues.zh: 也就是呼叫的工具名稱。

cues.en: And if there's any arguments, I build up a small arguments section.
cues.zh: 如果有參數，再建立簡單的參數區塊。

cues.en: That is what we see here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡顯示的內容。

cues.en: So, of course, we could just run this in line in the Blazor code, but I just wanted a small, simple one that could help us do it here.
cues.zh: 當然也能直接寫在 Blazor 中，但我希望有個簡單方法，方便這裡使用。

cues.en: And then, in order to show the result of that tool call, which happened in a different message, meaning the message that was for the tool,
cues.zh: 接著要顯示另一則工具訊息中的呼叫結果，

cues.en: we don't really want to show the tool thing here, because it's not part of the user and the message, or the assistant.
cues.zh: 不希望另外顯示一個獨立的 tool 訊息泡泡，因為它既不是 user，也不是 assistant。

cues.en: So what we're just going to do is we're taking our function call ID here and asking, find the one we actually want here.
cues.zh: 因此取得 Function CallId，再尋找對應結果。

cues.en: And we do that down here. We take our content ID.
cues.zh: 這部分在下面，先取得 Content 的 ID。

cues.en: In here, I'm checking if we have a conversation or not.
cues.zh: 這裡檢查是否有完整對話，

cues.en: That's because of some streaming.
cues.zh: 是為了處理串流情況。

cues.en: We don't need to care about that too much right now.
cues.zh: 現在先不用太在意。

cues.en: But in our case, we have a conversation.
cues.zh: 目前有完整對話。

cues.en: So we just take all the conversation contents, of course, all the messages, because we want to find the result,
cues.zh: 因此取得對話中所有訊息的 Content，因為要找到結果，

cues.en: meaning function result here, that match that tool call.
cues.zh: 也就是符合這個工具呼叫的 FunctionResult。

cues.en: Because, of course, whenever we do a tool call, we have a key value pair request and a response.
cues.zh: 每次工具呼叫，都有一組對應的要求與回應。

cues.en: So when we get that specific function tool call, if there, for some reason, haven't been any, we just return empty,
cues.zh: 找到對應結果。如果因為某種原因還沒有，就回傳空白，

cues.en: but else we get that specific one.
cues.zh: 否則取得那個特定結果。

cues.en: And that is what we see here.
cues.zh: 這就是畫面上的內容。

cues.en: And in our case, it's just because it's XML.
cues.zh: 這個例子回傳 XML，所以看起來是這樣。

cues.en: Other tools could give back JSON or just plain text.
cues.zh: 其他工具可能回傳 JSON，或只是純文字。

cues.en: And, of course, there could be exceptions.
cues.zh: 當然，也有可能發生例外。

cues.en: I haven't taken that into account here on how things should work, but normally exceptions, Agent 4.1 will just do a retry automatically.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有完整處理例外如何呈現。不過通常 Agent Framework 會自動進行重試。

cues.en: So that's the visuals of it, and we're just using what we got from the non-streaming call.
cues.zh: 這就是畫面呈現方式，使用的都是非串流呼叫回傳的資料。

cues.en: In the streaming call, we will see how we actually get this content on the fly from the various updates.
cues.zh: 串流單元則會介紹，如何從各次更新即時取得這些 Content。

cues.en: But that's everything there is to the tool calling part.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫的部分就是這樣。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
